strategy.name: Balanced Plus
strategy.summary: A fourth strategy next to Balanced, Safe and Aggressive: a diversified, minutes-secure squad judged over five gameweeks, built on underlying xG/xA rather than recent form.
rules: At most 2 players from any one club in the starting XI (the squad still obeys the FPL limit of 3).
XI players must be secure starters: start probability >= 75%, >= 60 expected minutes, availability >= 90%.
Objective value = discounted xPts over the next five gameweeks (weights 1 / 0.9 / 0.8 / 0.7 / 0.6), scaled by minutes security (0.6 + 0.2 x start probability + 0.2 x min(1, expected minutes / 80)).

Inside the objective, the player's own goal and assist terms are rebuilt from xG and xA only (realised goals and assists are excluded from those two terms). Bonus points, defensive contribution, saves, cards, team goals conceded and minutes/starts still come from realised data, exactly as in the shared projection model.
The recent-form tilt is removed from the objective. It is NOT removed from the displayed xPts or breakdown, and captaincy is chosen from the displayed xPts, so form can still influence the armband.

Strong playable bench: every outfield sub must have >= 50% start probability, the bench counts for 25% of a starter's value (Balanced: 12%), and the four bench players must total >= 12 xPts when feasible.
Captain = highest displayed (raw model) xPts in the XI, chosen independently of the squad objective. Vice = best remaining secure starter (>= 85% start) from a different club to the captain.
Same FPL data snapshot and same £100m budget as the other three strategies.

methodology.objectiveVersusDisplayedXpts: Two different numbers exist for every player. DISPLAYED xPts (tables, breakdown, captaincy, comparison metrics) come from the shared projection engine used by all four strategies. The Balanced Plus OBJECTIVE VALUE (what the solver maximises) is a separate five-gameweek quantity derived from it. The per-player table in this report shows both.
methodology.realisedDataInDisplayedXpts: goals and assists: 80% xG/xA + 20% realised; bonus, saves, defensive contribution and cards: realised per-90 rates; clean sheets and goals conceded: team goals against (50% realised) and xGA; minutes and starts: realised; positional priors include realised totals.
methodology.realisedDataInObjective: Excluded: the player's own realised goals and assists. Still included: bonus, defensive contribution, saves, cards, team goals conceded, minutes and starts.
methodology.form: Removed from the objective only. Present in displayed xPts (mean absolute size about 0.03 xPts per player; up to ~0.3) and therefore in captaincy.
methodology.minutesSecurity: Applied on top of a projection that already scales by expected minutes, so minutes are deliberately counted twice.
